name: lane-local-ai-gateway
description: A local, multi-provider AI gateway for desktop apps.
author: Haitian

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.e2e:mac:arm64: npm run package:e2e:mac:arm64 && cross-env LANE_E2E_APP_PATH=release/mac-arm64/Lane.app/Contents/MacOS/Lane npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:mac:x64: npm run package:e2e:mac:x64 && cross-env LANE_E2E_APP_PATH=release/mac/Lane.app/Contents/MacOS/Lane npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:win:x64: npm run package:e2e:win:x64 && cross-env LANE_E2E_APP_PATH=release/win-unpacked/Lane.exe npm run e2e
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:icon && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.inherit.plist
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build:icon && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir dmg --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.inherit.plist
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build:icon && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir dmg --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.inherit.plist
scripts.package:e2e:mac:arm64: npm run build:icon && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.inherit.plist
scripts.package:e2e:mac:x64: npm run build:icon && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.inherit.plist
scripts.package:e2e:win:x64: npm run build:native-host && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac:release:prepare: npm run build:icon && npm run build:release
scripts.package:mac:release: npm run package:mac:release:prepare && npm run package:mac:release:dist
scripts.package:mac:test: npm run package:mac:arm64 && npm run package:mac:x64
scripts.package:win:prepare: npm run build:icon && npm run build:native-host && npm run build
scripts.package:win: npm run package:win:prepare && npm run package:win:dist
scripts.package:win:release:prepare: npm run build:icon && npm run build:native-host && npm run build:release
scripts.package:win:release: npm run package:win:release:prepare && npm run package:win:release:dist
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:packaging
